name: Dealing With Death
overview: Scripture teaches that in the face of death, believers find comfort and strength in God's presence and care. The Lord is portrayed as a shepherd who provides and protects, even in the darkest valleys of death, offering reassurance that His rod and staff bring comfort. Those who mourn are promised blessing and consolation, as God is near to the brokenhearted and upholds His people with His righteous hand. This truth encourages believers to trust in God's sustaining power when dealing with the loss of a parent or other loved ones.
